correctness.rationale: If p divides |A| and n>=2, the wreath product has a noncyclic Sylow p-subgroup; seriality also descends to the quotient S_n. For p not dividing |A|, the split semisimple base decomposes the wreath algebra, via orbit full corners and inner place-permutation actions, into Morita classes of Young-subgroup group algebras. The known symmetric-group cyclic-defect classification then shows all such stabilizers are serial exactly in the stated ranges.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The symmetric-group classification and general wreath-product Morita methods are prior work and are cited as inputs. Targeted searches found no seriality theorem for finite-base symmetric wreath products, generalized symmetric groups, hyperoctahedral groups, or the characteristic-3 C2 wr S5 example, and no overlapping SCOPE record was found. The main residual risk is an implicit or differently phrased consequence in unindexed literature.

value.rationale: The result completely classifies serial group algebras for A wr S_n with arbitrary finite base A and yields an infinite family F[A wr S_5] of non-3-solvable serial group algebras in characteristic 3 for all finite 3'-groups A.
